newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 59.9 bln marks in tender at 3 pct rate.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 59.9 bln marks in tender at 3 pct rate.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it had allocated 59.9 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at a fixed three percent rate.

The central bank accepted 22.7 percent of the bids for the 12-day funds. A repo pact for 69 billion marks, also set at a fixed three percent rate, expires today, Wednesday, so a net 9.1 billion marks are draining from the market.
Funds will be credited to accounts on Thursday. At that time portions of the Bundesbank's annual profit will also be flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo, fixed at three percent since last August.
